---
title: "Confound"
output: html_document
---

```{r pull_clinch}

clinch_games <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT
    tg.team,
    tg.season,
    s.season_label,
    tg.game_date,
    tg.points,
    tc.clinch_date,
    tc.seed,
    tc.final_points
  FROM team_games tg
  JOIN team_clinch tc
    ON tc.team = tg.team AND tc.season = tg.season
  JOIN season_structure s
    ON s.season = tg.season
  WHERE tc.made_playoffs
")

nrow(clinch_games)   # expect 48 × 82 = 3936
```

```{r clinch_summary}

clinch_summary <- clinch_games |>
  mutate(window = if_else(game_date <= clinch_date, "pre", "post")) |>
  group_by(team, season, season_label, seed, final_points, window) |>
  summarise(
    points_pct = sum(points) / (2 * n()),
    games      = n(),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

clinch_wide <- clinch_summary |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = window, values_from = c(points_pct, games)) |>
  mutate(drop = points_pct_post - points_pct_pre)

clinch_wide |> arrange(games_post) |> head(5)   # check shortest post windows
```

```{r plot_clinch, fig.width=10, fig.height=4.5}

ggplot(clinch_wide, aes(x = points_pct_pre, y = drop)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60") +
  geom_point(aes(size = games_post), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ season_label) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 5), name = "Post-clinch\ngames") +
  labs(
    title    = "Playoff teams ease off after clinching their seed",
    subtitle = "Negative slope = stronger pre-clinch teams drop more (load management).",
    x        = "Pre-clinch points %",
    y        = "Drop = post − pre points %"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r fit_clinch}

fit_clinch    <- lm(drop ~ points_pct_pre, data = clinch_wide)
fit_clinch_w  <- lm(drop ~ points_pct_pre, data = clinch_wide, weights = games_post)
summary(fit_clinch)
summary(fit_clinch_w)
```

```{r magnitude}

b0 <- coef(fit_clinch_w)["(Intercept)"]
b1 <- coef(fit_clinch_w)["points_pct_pre"]

# Predicted drop for two hypothetical teams
contender_pre <- 0.700   # ~115-pt President's Trophy pace
bubble_pre    <- 0.550   # ~90-pt wild card

contender_drop <- b0 + b1 * contender_pre
bubble_drop    <- b0 + b1 * bubble_pre

cat(sprintf(
  "Contender (0.700 pre-clinch pts%%): predicted drop = %.3f pts%%\n", contender_drop))
cat(sprintf(
  "Bubble    (0.550 pre-clinch pts%%): predicted drop = %.3f pts%%\n", bubble_drop))

# Convert drop in pts% over an N-game post-clinch window to points "given back"
typical_post_games <- median(clinch_wide$games_post, na.rm = TRUE)

contender_points_lost <- -contender_drop * 2 * typical_post_games
bubble_points_lost    <- -bubble_drop    * 2 * typical_post_games

cat(sprintf(
  "Over %.0f post-clinch games, contender gives back ~%.1f standings points vs maintaining pace.\n",
  typical_post_games, contender_points_lost))
cat(sprintf(
  "Bubble team gives back ~%.1f standings points.\n", bubble_points_lost))
```


**Biggest Dropped Teams**

```{r leaderboard}

clinch_wide |>
  filter(!is.na(drop), games_post >= 5) |>     # filter out unreliable short windows
  arrange(drop) |>
  select(season_label, team, seed, points_pct_pre, points_pct_post, games_post, drop) |>
  head(10)
```

**Maintained Pace**
```{r anti_leaderboard}

clinch_wide |>
  filter(!is.na(drop), games_post >= 5) |>
  arrange(desc(drop)) |>
  select(season_label, team, seed, points_pct_pre, points_pct_post, games_post, drop) |>
  head(10)
```
